reuse.why: Uses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend, and extracts the weekend-adjust-to-day step into getOccurrenceDay that both getUpcomingDates and the new handler call.

duplication.why: The weekend handling is shared; only the small handler skeleton (build rules, RSchedule, try/catch captureBreadcrumb) is repeated from getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: The handler sits next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered the same way; the weekend rule stays in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the new handler, the extracted helper with getUpcomingDates switched to it, and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and small; the MAX_WEEKEND_SHIFT_DAYS padding is a named constant tied implicitly to the weekend helper's maximum shift, which a maintainer has to keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Weekend adjustment goes through getDateWithSkippedWeekend via getOccurrenceDay.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic beyond the open handler skeleton.
